text:
elaine.k: flagging an oddity from this morning's invoice generation: tenant 'bigdata-acme' got two drafts and one of them is missing the GPU compute line. noticed in QA before emails went out.

omar.p: any idea if PDFs were sent?

elaine.k: drafts only. batch id rb-20260607-1. billing-bot shows anomaly tag 'trimmed_lines' and 'duplicate_draft'.

billing-bot: Reconciliation report: batch=rb-20260607-1, processed=1021, anomalies=[duplicate_draft, trimmed_lines, credit_applied_mismatch].

vivian.rev: missing GPU line = big deal for rev recognition. which draft has it missing?

elaine.k: INV-2026-0607A (tenant bigdata-acme-primary) missing compute_gpu_hours. INV-2026-0607B (bigdata-acme-ops) has a reserved_capacity_credit line that should belong to tenant_primary. looks like credit landed on the sibling tenant and caused rounding to drop the compute line in draft A.

mike.s: Could be two things: 1) credits posted to wrong tenant id during batch, 2) our suppress-small-lines filter removed a line whose net display amount rounded to 0. We recently tweaked rounding to cents.

omar.p: can you paste the draft snippet?

elaine.k: snippet:
```
INV-2026-0607A - bigdata-acme-primary
- compute_gpu_hours: 256 -> $25,600.00
- inference_requests: 2,000,000 -> $5,600.00
- reserved_capacity_credit: -$25,600.00  <-- expected but MISSING
TOTAL: $5,600.00

INV-2026-0607B - bigdata-acme-ops
- reserved_capacity_credit: -$25,600.00  <-- applied here by mistake
- other_services: $120.00
TOTAL: -$25,480.00
```

vivian.rev: that negative total triggers suppression and weird rounding behavior. we'll need a clean audit trail for the credit move.

mike.s: quick detection queries to run before we touch DB:
```
-- credits posted to tenant != invoice tenant in last 7 days
SELECT cp.credit_id, cp.posted_to_tenant, i.tenant_id AS invoice_tenant, i.invoice_number
FROM credit_postings cp
JOIN invoices i ON i.id = cp.invoice_id
WHERE cp.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND cp.posted_to_tenant <> i.tenant_id;

-- invoices with compute lines but missing in rendered PDF
SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, cl.amount_cents, pdf.exists
FROM invoices i
JOIN compute_lines cl ON cl.invoice_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN pdf_lines pdf ON pdf.invoice_id = i.id AND pdf.code = 'compute_gpu_hours'
WHERE cl.amount_cents > 0 AND (pdf.exists IS FALSE OR pdf.exists IS NULL);
```

omar.p: thanks. run those and share results. I also want to pause auto-accept fuzzy fixes for billing like last time.

billing-bot: Action created: tas-5012 (label: credit-misalloc). Assigned to @mike.s.

mike.s: ran detections: found 4 matches in last 14 days, plus the current case. Pausing fuzzy auto-accept for billing rules now. Uploading CSV to /shared/finance/misalloc-20260607.csv

vivian.rev: finance: we need approval steps: 1) manual reassignment of credit to tenant_primary with journal entry, 2) regenerate consolidated invoice INV-2026-0607 (single final invoice), 3) issue credit note referencing original drafts for audit.

elaine.k: customer comms draft (short):
"We discovered duplicate draft invoices for your account. Only one final invoice will be issued shortly; please disregard drafts. We are correcting a credit allocation issue internally and will send the corrected invoice with an audit note. Apologies for the confusion."

omar.p: agreed. mike, once you have CSV and proposed SQL updates we'll schedule the reissue. Also open an alert: when reserved_credit_posting.tenant_id != invoice.tenant_id for any batch > 0 occurrences.

mike.s: will open alert ticket and attach audit CSV to tas-5012. ETA for manual reassignment + regen: 2 hours pending finance signoff.

vivian.rev: ACK. i'll coordinate signoff and confirm timing for revenue entries.

elaine.k: thanks team — closing until regen completes. reopen if customer complains.
